returningInjured.comment: The Twins placed Buxton on the 10-day injured list Sunday due to a right hip impingement.
Hoskins (back) is feeling better but has not yet resumed baseball activity, MLB.com reports.

Manager Aaron Boone stated Monday that Judge (ribs) could be activated from the 60-day injured list during the Yankees' upcoming homestand, which runs from Sept. 8 - Sept. 13, Gary Phillips of the New York Daily News reports.
Wetherholt was given a cortisone injection Tuesday to combat tendinitis in his right wrist, Derrick Goold of the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reports.
San Diego placed Sheets on the 10-day injured list Sunday with a left foot sprain.
Contreras (hamstring) was removed from Sunday's 16-1 loss to the Yankees in the seventh inning, Christopher Smith of MassLive.com reports.
Carpenter (foot) was on track to have his walking boot removed this past weekend, MLB.com reports.
The Cubs placed Swanson (oblique) on the 10-day injured list Monday, Taylor McGregor of Marquee Sports Network reports.
Mead (wrist) played catch on the field at Fenway Park on Monday, Mac Cerullo of the Boston Herald reports.
Adames got a second opinion on his elbow Thursday and is expected to miss three to four weeks, Alex Pavlovic of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
Pirates director of sports medicine Todd Tomczyk said Monday that O'Hearn (quadriceps) has been cleared to play catch and take some swings in the batting cage, Jason Mackey of MLB.com reports.
The Athletics announced Monday that Langeliers (knee) has begun hitting and throwing progressions, Martin Gallegos of MLB.com reports.
Pages had a compression screw inserted into his fractured left hand Sunday in an attempt to expedite healing, Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic reports.
Steer (wrist) may not return before the end of the season, Patrick Brown of MLB.com reports.
The Mariners transferred Raley (forearm) from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day IL on Wednesday.
The Athletics transferred Kurtz (thumb) to the 60-day injured list Friday.
The Giants transferred Schmitt (knee) to the 60-day injured list Saturday.
The Athletics transferred Soderstrom (hip) to the 60-day injured list Thursday.
